name: Morning light on the bar
summary: Your bar in soft daylight, with a slow camera move and rising steam.
outcome: A slow camera move across your bar or espresso machine in soft morning daylight, with a little steam rising and light moving over the counter.
photoGuidance: A photo of your bar, counter or espresso machine.
Daylight works best. Avoid heavy filters.
Keep the counter clear of clutter you don't want in the video.
limitations: Text and logos in your photo may change in the video. Check the result before you post it.

inputs.label: What's in the photo
inputs.help: A few words, such as 'espresso machine and two cups on an oak counter'.
inputs.example: Espresso machine on an oak counter

options.label: Gentle
options.prompt: The camera moves very little, a slow and steady drift.

options.label: Slow push-in
options.prompt: The camera pushes in slowly and steadily towards the subject.

options.label: Sideways glide
options.prompt: The camera glides slowly and steadily to one side, keeping the subject in frame.

inputs.label: Details to keep as they are
inputs.help: Optional. For example, the colour of your cups or the shape of a sign.

inputs.label: Anything to leave out
inputs.help: Optional. For example, no smoke or no people.

prompt.preserve: Keep everything in the photo recognisable: the same objects, shapes, colours and proportions. Keep any printed text, labels and logos as they are.
prompt.avoid: Do not add people, hands, text, captions, logos or new objects. No sudden cuts, no camera shake, no warping or melting of surfaces.
prompt.subject: The photo shows {subject} in a specialty coffee shop.
prompt.composition: Keep the framing of the photo, with the bar as the main subject.
prompt.environment: The cafe is clean and tidy, as in the photo.
prompt.subjectMotion: A thin wisp of steam rises from the machine or the cups. Everything else on the counter stays still.
prompt.lighting: Soft morning daylight from a window, with gentle light moving slowly across the counter.
prompt.mood: Calm and inviting, like the first quiet minutes after opening.
